# Golden statement sequences

`<scenario>.golden` holds the DDL statements that a real tool wrote to the binlog of MySQL 8.4 for
the migration named by the scenario, one statement per line, normalized by `migrationsim.Normalize`
(whitespace collapsed, the database qualifier, the `/* xid=... */` and `/* generated by server */`
comments and the `use` prefix removed). The table was `orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, v VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
qty INT NOT NULL)` with five rows; the alter of each scenario is in `scenarios_test.go`.

To refresh them after a new version of a tool, run the tool against a MySQL container with the
same table, read the statements with `SHOW BINLOG EVENTS` (Query events), normalize them and
replace the file. The test `TestSimulationMatchesTheStatementsOfTheRealTools` then shows what the
simulation has to change. `BINWAVE_TEST_REAL_TOOLS=1 go test -tags e2e ./test/e2e -run RealTools`
runs the real tools under load against binwave, which is the other half of the same check.
